summary: A rival's complaint leads a state commission to fine a campaign for gifts that went unreported for weeks near an election.
realLife: A state commission issued two penalties against a mayor's campaign for contributions reported weeks late, under a rule for large gifts in the final days, after a rival's complaint; the campaign could pay or appeal.
sources: Anchorage Daily News, state fines mayor for campaign finance violations, Aug. 9, 2021: https://adn.com/alaska-news/anchorage/2021/08/09/state-fines-anchorage-mayor-bronson-33500-for-campaign-finance-violations
inGame: needs: a late-contribution rule near election day and a complaint step with penalty notices

turns.writesBack: a payment and a short story

turns.turn: The campaign appeals and argues no intent
